free_tier.stated: No free tier: 'LEECHALL.IO is a paid service that allows you to download files instantly at the best Internet speed.'
free_tier.notes: The free sibling is leechall.com, which is a separate tier with its own caps.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: not applicable: links are generated and consumed, not stored

egress.terms: Downloads are served from Leechall's own network at 'the best Internet speed'. The only price the page states is the entry point, 'Price from $2.99', referenced from the free site's banner; the checkout page was not opened, so the period that $2.99 buys is unverified.

interface_detail: Web interface. Payments accepted: 'Card, Paypal, Cryptocurrency, Payeer, Binance Pay, WebMoney'. No API endpoint is published on the page read.
tooling: browser only as read; no client library, no rclone backend.
chaining: A paid per-download leecher that removes the ads from the free sibling. At $2.99 it is the cheapest way to test whether an otherwise unsupported host can be pulled at all before paying that host's own premium.

limits.value: unknown: no byte or file allowance was published on the page read

limits_note: The page advertises 'a lower price than the majority of file hosters' and no allowance. Whether it meters bytes, files or time is unstated, which is the gap a buyer needs closed before paying.
binding_note: Named as volume-quota because that is the shape a one-time leecher purchase almost always takes, not because the number was read. The number is unverified.

identity_cost.detail: A purchase through a payment processor; the page shows no free account path. Card, PayPal or crypto at checkout. The exact fields at signup were not read.

reliability_note: One-time payment, no subscription, so there is no recurring charge to cancel; that also means no refund path stated on the page read.
confidence_note: The checkout was not opened. Reading the checkout page would move the period and allowance to documented.

evidence.proved: paid-only service, one-time payment, the payment-method list, and 'Leechall.com has been trusted since 2016'
the banner 'Leechall.io - Download File Instantly Without Any Ads - Price from $2.99', which is where the entry price is stated

evidence.quote: LEECHALL.IO is a paid service that allows you to download files instantly at the best Internet speed.
Now accepting Card, Paypal, Cryptocurrency, Payeer, Binance Pay, WebMoney ...and more.

evidence.proved: the entry price 'Price from $2.99' is still the only price stated
evidence.quote: [Leechall.io - Download File Instantly Without Any Ads - Price from $2.99](https://leechall.io/)

notes: Two records for one operator because the tiers differ in kind: the free site caps bytes per host, the paid site sells a one-time ad-free allowance. A reader acts on one of them.
